title: 生物修复与生物技术应用
source_doc: course/高校实验室安全/182_生物修复与生物技术应用.md
author_source: project/高校实验室安全/182_生物修复与生物技术应用/src.py

shots.scene: 欣欣捧着一盘干净的土壤和一株小苗
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a small tray of clean soil with a green seedling, tiny friendly microbe icons floating around it, looking at the camera.
shots.narration: 第15章第二十课：生物修复与生物技术应用。
overlay: 生物修复与生物技术应用

shots.scene: 阿杰拿着一瓶菌液，想倒到楼下的油污地面上
shots.prompt_en: The young male student carries a flask of cloudy culture toward an oily patch on the ground outside the lab building, a red warning icon.
shots.narration: 阿杰想把吃油菌倒到楼下油污上试试。

shots.scene: 王老师拦住，指向实验室和灭菌袋
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator stops him at the door and points back to the lab bench and a sealed autoclave bag.
shots.narration: 王老师：实验菌株，不能私自放到环境里。

shots.scene: 小研拿着一张空白流程图
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in a lab coat holds a blank flow chart sheet, nodding. The sheet is blank.
shots.narration: 小研：原理要懂，审批和规程更要守。

shots.scene: 一张清单：起床后做过的事
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a blank checklist next to icons of a toothbrush, breakfast, clothes and a bus. No text.
shots.narration: 先想想：今天起床后，你都做了什么？

shots.scene: 番茄、大豆、玉米、牛奶、棉花、燃料、胰岛素
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: icons of a tomato, soybeans, corn, a milk carton, cotton, a fuel can and an insulin vial in a circle. No text.
shots.narration: 吃的穿的用的，很多都和生物技术有关。

shots.scene: 世界地图上食物供应不均
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a world map with uneven colored patches of food supply, a plate icon empty in some regions. No text.
shots.narration: 全球食物分配不均，营养不良很普遍。

shots.scene: 抗虫、营养强化、增产、节水节肥
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a crop plant with four icons around it, a shield against a pest, a vitamin, a rising yield bar and a water drop. No text.
shots.narration: 抗虫、营养强化、增产，还省水省肥。

shots.scene: 有益微生物改良土壤、促生长、防病虫
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: friendly microbe icons around plant roots in soil, the plant growing taller, a pest icon pushed away. No text.
shots.narration: 有益微生物能改良土壤、防病虫。

shots.scene: 转基因食品：安全评价和标识管理
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a food package with a blank label and an evaluation checklist with a stamp beside it. No text.
shots.narration: 转基因食品，国家实行安全评价和标识。

shots.scene: 乙醇、沼气、生物柴油
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a fermentation tank producing three fuel icons, an alcohol flask, a gas bubble and a diesel drop. No text.
shots.narration: 石油会用完，生物技术能产乙醇和沼气。

shots.scene: 生产菌种送到工厂产酶
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a small sealed culture tube going to a large factory fermenter that outputs enzyme bottles. No text.
shots.narration: 工业上，生产菌种用来生产酶和燃料。

shots.scene: 面包、酸奶靠发酵
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: bread and a cup of yogurt with yeast, lactic acid bacteria and mold icons beside them. No text.
shots.narration: 面包酸奶靠酵母、乳酸菌和霉菌发酵。

shots.scene: 诊断更快、用药因人而异
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a fast diagnostic test strip, a personalized medicine pill matched to a person icon, a target arrow. No text.
shots.narration: 诊断更快更准，用药可以因人而异。

shots.scene: 改造的细菌生产胰岛素
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an engineered bacterium in a fermenter producing insulin vials. No text.
shots.narration: 改造生物来产药，叫生物制药，如胰岛素。

shots.scene: 写下你对未来与伦理的想法
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student writes in a notebook at a desk, a balance scale icon and a question mark above her.
shots.narration: 伦理和需求，会怎样影响生物技术未来？

shots.scene: 微生物把污染物变成无害物质
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: microbes eating a dark pollutant blob and releasing clean water drops and harmless bubbles. No text.
shots.narration: 生物修复：请微生物把污染变无害。

shots.scene: 油污、化学品泄漏、重金属
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three polluted scenes, an oily beach, a spilled chemical drum and a metal contaminated pond, microbe icons in each. No text.
shots.narration: 能处理油污、化学品泄漏和重金属。

shots.scene: 污水处理厂的曝气池
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a wastewater treatment plant with an aeration tank full of microbe icons. No text.
shots.narration: 污水处理厂，也靠微生物干活。

shots.scene: 含酶洗涤剂
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a laundry detergent box with an enzyme icon breaking a stain apart. No text.
shots.narration: 含酶洗涤剂，也是小小的生物技术。

shots.scene: 油滴周围的细菌
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: rod shaped bacteria gathering around a floating oil droplet on water. No text.
shots.narration: 有些细菌专吃石油烃，如假单胞菌。

shots.scene: 烃类既是食物又是能量
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hydrocarbon chain going into a bacterium, an energy bolt and a growing cell icon coming out. No text.
shots.narration: 它们把烃类当碳源和能源，用来生长。

shots.scene: 氧化成脂肪酸，最终二氧化碳和水
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a long chain molecule broken step by step into a short fatty acid, then into carbon dioxide and water drops. No text.
shots.narration: 先氧化成脂肪酸，最终变成二氧化碳和水。

shots.scene: 烃类生物降解治理油污
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an oil slick shrinking on the sea as microbe icons spread, a check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 这叫烃类生物降解，是治理油污的办法。

shots.scene: 细菌分解土里的有机磷农药
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: soil with pesticide droplet icons slowly removed by bacteria. No text.
shots.narration: 恶臭假单胞菌能分解有机磷农药残留。

shots.scene: 芽孢杆菌分解除草剂
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a herbicide molecule icon broken apart by rod shaped bacteria with spore dots. No text.
shots.narration: 芽孢杆菌等能分解阿特拉津类除草剂。

shots.scene: 降解菌来自环境，先评估
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a soil sample jar going to a magnifier and a risk checklist before culture. No text.
shots.narration: 降解菌多从环境分离，培养前先评估。

shots.scene: 白腐真菌长在朽木上
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: white fungal threads on a rotting log, enzyme scissors cutting a tough lignin mesh. No text.
shots.narration: 白腐真菌分泌酶，拆开坚硬的木质素。

shots.scene: 同一套酶拆含氯农药
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the same enzyme scissors cutting a chlorinated pesticide molecule. No text.
shots.narration: 这套酶不挑食，能拆难降解的含氯农药。

shots.scene: 染料废水褪色
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a beaker of deep blue dye water turning pale as fungal threads grow. No text.
shots.narration: 还能拆持久性污染物，让染料废水褪色。

shots.scene: 金属不能被消灭
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a heavy metal atom icon that stays the same while its form changes, an arrow from dissolved to solid. No text.
shots.narration: 重金属不会消失，微生物改它形态或固定。

shots.scene: 六价铬还原成三价铬
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: bacteria passing electrons to a toxic metal icon, which turns into a less toxic form. No text.
shots.narration: 地杆菌、希瓦氏菌把六价铬还原成三价铬。

shots.scene: 细胞壁像海绵吸附铅镉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a bacterium with a sponge like cell wall catching metal ions on its surface. No text.
shots.narration: 耐金属的细菌，把铅镉吸附在细胞壁上。

shots.scene: 汞转化后仍有毒
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a mercury droplet icon changing into another form with a warning triangle still attached. No text.
shots.narration: 有些细菌能转化汞，但产物仍然有毒。

shots.scene: 炸药污染的土壤由微生物慢慢清理
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a fenced off contaminated soil area with microbe icons slowly cleaning it. No text.
shots.narration: 被炸药污染的土壤，可借微生物清理。

shots.scene: 梭菌在缺氧下还原硝基
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an oxygen free zone with bacteria changing parts of a molecule icon from one group to another. No text.
shots.narration: 梭菌在缺氧环境，把TNT的硝基还原。

shots.scene: RDX分解成更简单的物质
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a ring molecule icon broken into small simple pieces by two kinds of bacteria. No text.
shots.narration: 假单胞菌、红球菌能分解RDX。

shots.scene: 可溶的铀变成不溶，不随水跑
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: dissolved metal dots flowing in groundwater, then bacteria turning them into solid grains that stay in place. No text.
shots.narration: 地杆菌把可溶的铀还原成不溶的，不扩散。

shots.scene: 炸药和放射性物质学生不得接触
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an explosive symbol and a radiation trefoil behind a locked gate, a student icon crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 炸药和放射性物质受严管，学生不得接触。

shots.scene: 噬菌体感染细菌后把它撑破
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a lunar lander shaped virus attaching to a bacterium, copies inside, then the cell bursting. No text.
shots.narration: 噬菌体是专感染细菌的病毒。

shots.scene: 只认特定细菌，有益菌不伤
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: viruses attaching only to red bacteria while green friendly bacteria stay untouched. No text.
shots.narration: 它只认特定细菌，有益微生物不受伤。

shots.scene: 污水和医院环境里清除致病菌
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a sewage pipe and a hospital building icon, viruses targeting red bacteria in both. No text.
shots.narration: 可用于污水和医院环境，精准清除致病菌。

shots.scene: 强酸强碱废水，微生物间接帮忙
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two industrial wastewater tanks, one acidic and one alkaline, microbes helping from the side. No text.
shots.narration: 酸碱很强的废水，微生物只能间接帮忙。

shots.scene: 嗜酸菌在酸性废物中生长
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: bacteria thriving in a low pH tank with a sulfur cycle arrow icon. No text.
shots.narration: 嗜酸菌能在酸性废物里生长，参与硫转化。

shots.scene: 嗜碱菌产有机酸降pH
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: bacteria in an alkaline tank releasing small acid drops, a pH meter needle moving toward neutral. No text.
shots.narration: 嗜碱菌产有机酸，把碱性废水pH降下来。

shots.scene: 有毒气体穿过生物滤池
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: polluted gas flowing up through a packed filter bed coated with microbes, clean air out the top. No text.
shots.narration: 生物滤池里，微生物把有毒气体当食物。

shots.scene: 氨变亚硝酸盐，硫化氢变硫酸盐
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two conversion arrows, an ammonia icon to a nitrite icon and a rotten egg gas icon to a sulfate icon, a microbe on each. No text.
shots.narration: 氨氧化成亚硝酸盐，硫化氢氧化成硫酸盐。

shots.scene: 改造基因对付危险废物
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a bacterium with a highlighted gene region pointing to a hazardous waste drum, three arrows for three directions. No text.
shots.narration: 工程菌：改造基因，专门对付危险废物。

shots.scene: 多产降解酶
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a bacterium releasing many enzyme scissors that break pollutants faster. No text.
shots.narration: 一是多产降解酶，分解得更快。

shots.scene: 耐得住高浓度毒物
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a bacterium with a shield surviving in a dark toxic pool. No text.
shots.narration: 二是耐得住毒，高浓度也能干活。

shots.scene: 遇砷发光的生物传感器
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a tube of water with bacteria glowing green when a toxic element icon is present, a dark tube without it. No text.
shots.narration: 三是当传感器：如水里有砷就发荧光。

shots.scene: 工程菌留在实验室
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a glowing bacterium icon inside a closed lab boundary with an approval stamp at the door. No text.
shots.narration: 工程菌是转基因生物，只在批准范围用。

shots.scene: 燃料电池里的细菌分解废物
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a two chamber cell with bacteria on an electrode eating waste particles. No text.
shots.narration: 微生物燃料电池：电活性细菌分解废物。

shots.scene: 电子流向电极，小灯泡亮
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: electrons flowing from the bacteria along a wire to light a small bulb. No text.
shots.narration: 电子流向电极，解了毒，还发了电。

shots.scene: 单菌本事有限，混合菌群互补
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: one lonely bacterium with a small toolbox next to a team of different microbes with combined tools. No text.
shots.narration: 单一菌株本事有限，混合菌群代谢互补。

shots.scene: 一种先拆，其他接力
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a relay race of microbes passing smaller and smaller molecule pieces until a harmless drop remains. No text.
shots.narration: 一种菌先拆大分子，其他菌接力收尾。

shots.scene: 海上油污：好氧厌氧配合
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a sea cross section with oxygen loving microbes near the surface and oxygen free microbes in the sediment, both working on oil. No text.
shots.narration: 清理海上油污，要好氧菌厌氧菌配合。

shots.scene: 从土壤、污水、油污中分离菌
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: sample jars of soil, sewage and oily sand with unknown microbe icons and a question mark. No text.
shots.narration: 环境分离菌来源不明，鉴定前按未知菌。

shots.scene: 风险评估确定防护级别
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a risk matrix and a lab level badge chosen with a pen, a biosafety cabinet icon. No text.
shots.narration: 先做风险评估，再确定防护级别。

shots.scene: 【实拍】给培养管贴标签
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of gloved hands sticking a blank label on a closed culture tube and placing it in a rack.
shots.narration: 培养物标清来源、代次和日期。

shots.scene: 厌氧培养产气，通风处开启
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a sealed anaerobic bottle with gas bubbles and a pressure icon, opened slowly inside a fume hood. No text.
shots.narration: 厌氧培养会产气，在通风处缓慢开启。

shots.scene: 投到土壤水体就是环境释放
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a flask of culture with an arrow to soil and a river, a red stop sign on the arrow. No text.
shots.narration: 菌剂投到土壤水体，就是向环境释放。

shots.scene: 转基因微生物先安全评价、审批
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an application file passing a biosafety committee table and a government review stamp. No text.
shots.narration: 转基因微生物，先安全评价、依法审批。

shots.scene: 未经批准不带出、不投放
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a backpack with a culture flask crossed out at the lab door, a drain with a flask crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 未经批准，不带出、不投放、不排放。

shots.scene: 实验结束灭活处置
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: used flasks and plates going into an autoclave, then a waste log with a check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 实验结束，培养物灭活后再处置。

shots.scene: 农药、重金属、砷、油和溶剂
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: icons of a pesticide bottle, a heavy metal salt jar, a toxic skull bottle and a flammable solvent can on a shelf. No text.
shots.narration: 农药、重金属、砷、油和溶剂，本身就危险。

shots.scene: 通风柜内少量操作，戴手套护目镜
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in goggles and gloves measures a small amount of liquid inside a fume hood.
shots.narration: 通风柜内少量操作，戴手套和护目镜。

shots.scene: 【实拍】把清水倒入贴标签的废液桶
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of gloved hands pouring clear water through a funnel into a labeled waste container, then closing the cap.
shots.narration: 含重金属、农药的废液单独收集。

shots.scene: 不倒下水道，汞洒落不扫不吸
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a sink drain crossed out, a broom and a vacuum cleaner crossed out next to small mercury beads. No text.
shots.narration: 不倒下水道；汞洒落不扫不吸，先报告。

shots.scene: 新发现走向生产要很多年
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a long winding road from a lab flask to a factory, many checkpoints and a calendar along the way. No text.
shots.narration: 新成果变产品，要大量时间、检测和试验。

shots.scene: 四个环节：生产、风险、监管、测试
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: four connected boxes with a factory icon, a risk scale, a stamp and a repeated test icon. No text.
shots.narration: 生产、风险分析、监管、测试，一环不少。

shots.scene: 反复测试，找副作用
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: many test tubes with the same result marked, a magnifier finding a small side effect icon. No text.
shots.narration: 反复测试，结果要可重复，找出副作用。

shots.scene: 放大前重新评估
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a small flask growing into a large fermenter, a risk checklist stamped again in between. No text.
shots.narration: 从小试到中试放大，要重新评估审批。

shots.scene: 田间试验分阶段审批
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a fenced isolated test field with stage markers, each stage gate with an approval stamp. No text.
shots.narration: 上田间要分阶段报告审批，不能自行种植。

shots.scene: 良好生产规范管质量和安全
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a clean production line with a quality shield and a safety helmet icon. No text.
shots.narration: 良好生产规范，管的是质量和安全。

shots.scene: 记录、培训、监测、规程、维护
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: five icons in a row, a logbook, a training board, a gauge, a procedure binder and a wrench. No text.
shots.narration: 记录、培训、监测、规程、维护，样样有。

shots.scene: 原料合格，每批一致
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a checked raw material bag and identical product batches lined up. No text.
shots.narration: 原料要合格，每一批质量都要一致。

shots.scene: 监管部门全程把关
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a product moving along a path with three guard posts, each with a stamp. No text.
shots.narration: 新技术进入市场，监管部门全程把关。

shots.scene: 食品药品、农业、环境各管一方
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three gate icons, a food and medicine icon, a crop icon and a tree icon, each checking a document. No text.
shots.narration: 食品药品、农业、环境，各管一方面。

shots.scene: 测试吃油微生物在不同条件下的效果
shots.prompt_en: The young male student and the female graduate student set up small closed flasks with oil drops on a bench, wearing goggles and gloves.
shots.narration: 项目一：测试吃油微生物在不同条件下的效果。

shots.scene: 用教师发放的菌剂，结束灭活
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a teacher hand giving a labeled culture vial, a closed lab boundary, an autoclave icon at the end. No text.
shots.narration: 用老师发放的菌剂，做完全部灭活。

shots.scene: 画出从实验室到市场的路线图
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student draws a road map from a flask to a store on a big blank sheet, with checkpoint icons.
shots.narration: 项目二：画出从实验室到市场的路线图。

shots.scene: 生物技术：粮食、能源、环境、健康
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: four icons, a grain ear, a fuel drop, a tree and a heart, all checked. No text.
shots.narration: 生物技术用于粮食、能源、环境和健康。

shots.scene: 微生物、真菌、噬菌体、混合菌群
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a bacterium, a fungus, a phage and a microbe team cleaning a polluted area. No text.
shots.narration: 修复靠降解、转化、固定，金属不会消失。

shots.scene: 按未知菌评估，环境释放须审批
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a risk checklist, an approval stamp and a door with a culture flask crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 环境菌先评估，不审批不释放，废物灭活。

shots.scene: 欣欣翻开一本实验记录本
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot opens a bound lab notebook with blank numbered pages and holds a pen, waving goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课：实验设计、记录与数据。
